PF2EActionForge.Title: PF2E Action Forge
PF2EActionForge.Subtitle: Fast access to character actions
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Label: Acting character
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.Hint: Follow the controlled token automatically, or pin a specific actor from the list. While an action is in progress, the acting character is frozen.
PF2EActionForge.SourceActor.NoneHint: Control one of your creature tokens or choose an owned character, companion, or familiar.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Heading: Actions
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CatalogHint: Choose an action, assign its targets and DC, and keep frequently used actions close at hand as favorites.
Recall information with an appropriate knowledge or Lore skill; the roll and outcome remain hidden according to PF2e secret-check handling.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TumbleThrough.De: Acrobatics against a creature's Reflex DC while moving through its space.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Grapple.Name: Grapple
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Grapple.Descript: Athletics against Fortitude DC to seize a creature.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Name: Trip
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Trip.Description: Athletics against Reflex DC to knock a creature prone.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Name: Climb
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Climb.Descriptio: Athletics against an environmental DC to move along an incline or vertical surface.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Name: Lie
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Lie.Description: Deception against one target’s Perception DC; the roll and outcome are hidden from players.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Name: Demoralize
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Demoralize.Descr: Intimidation against Will DC to frighten a creature.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Name: Treat Wounds
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatWounds.Desc: Treat a living creature’s wounds with Medicine; healing, Wounded removal, and the 60-minute immunity are managed from the result.
PF2EActionForge.Search.Label: Search actions
PF2EActionForge.Favorites.Heading: Favorites
PF2EActionForge.Favorites.Hint: Personal shortcuts saved for this Foundry user.

PF2EActionForge.Actions.Balance.Name: Balance
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Balance.Descript: Acrobatics against an environmental DC to move across narrow surfaces or uneven ground.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Squeeze.Name: Squeeze
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Squeeze.Descript: Trained Acrobatics against an environmental DC to move through exceptionally tight spaces.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Shove.Name: Shove
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Shove.Descriptio: Athletics against Fortitude DC to force a target away from you.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Reposition.Name: Reposition
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Reposition.Descr: Athletics against Fortitude DC to move a target while keeping it within your reach.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Disarm.Name: Disarm
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Disarm.Descripti: Trained Athletics against Reflex DC to weaken a foe's grip or knock an item from its hand.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.ForceOpen.Name: Force Open
PF2EActionForge.Actions.ForceOpen.Descri: Athletics against an environmental DC to force open doors, windows, containers, or other obstacles.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Swim.Name: Swim
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Swim.Description: Athletics against an environmental DC based on the water to move through it under your own power.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.HighJump.Name: High Jump
PF2EActionForge.Actions.HighJump.Descrip: Athletics against DC 30 after a run-up to jump higher than a normal Leap.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.LongJump.Name: Long Jump
PF2EActionForge.Actions.LongJump.Descrip: Athletics against DC 15 after a run-up; your possible jump distance depends on the check result.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CreateADiversion: Deception against Perception DC to draw a creature's attention elsewhere and become hidden from it.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Feint.Name: Feint
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Feint.Descriptio: Trained Deception against a foe's Perception DC to create an opening for your melee attack.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Perform.Name: Perform
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Perform.Descript: Give a short performance using Performance against a DC set by the GM or the situation.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.MakeAnImpression: Use Diplomacy against a creature’s Will DC to improve its attitude toward you for the current social interaction.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Request.Name: Request
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Request.Descript: Ask a friendly or helpful creature for something; the DC depends on how difficult the request is.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.GatherInformatio: Spend exploration time asking about a topic or person; the GM determines the time and DC and resolves the Diplomacy check secretly.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Impersonate.Name: Impersonate
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Impersonate.Desc: Create a disguise; when an observer has reason to scrutinize it, Deception is checked secretly against the relevant Perception DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Coerce.Name: Coerce
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Coerce.Descripti: Threaten a creature for at least 1 minute and check Intimidation against its Will DC to force compliance.
Hide a small object; when an observer could notice it, Stealth is checked secretly against the relevant Perception DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Hide.Name: Hide
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Hide.Description: Use cover or concealment to hide; the Stealth check is resolved secretly against relevant observers’ Perception DCs.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Sneak.Name: Sneak
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Sneak.Descriptio: Move at no more than half Speed and secretly try to become or remain undetected by observers.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Subsist.Name: Subsist
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Subsist.Descript: Find food and shelter with Society in a settlement or Survival in the wilderness.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.SenseDirection.D: Orient yourself from environmental clues; the GM determines the DC and resolves the Survival check secretly.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Track.Name: Track
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Track.Descriptio: Follow a trail with trained Survival; the DC depends on freshness, weather, terrain, and other circumstances.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CoverTracks.Name: Cover Tracks
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CoverTracks.Desc: Obscure your trail while moving at half travel Speed. You normally make no check; trackers use your Survival DC if it is higher than the normal Track DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.PalmAnObject.Des: Palm a small unattended object unnoticed and roll Thievery against an observer's Perception DC. For multiple observers, the current workflow resolves one observer per roll.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Steal.Name: Steal
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Steal.Descriptio: Try to take a small object from another creature unnoticed, normally rolling Thievery against its Perception DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.DisableADevice.D: Use trained Thievery to disable a trap or complex mechanism. The GM sets the DC and, where appropriate, the number of successes required.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.PickALock.Name: Pick a Lock
PF2EActionForge.Actions.PickALock.Descri: Use trained Thievery and thieves' tools to pick a lock. Complex locks can require multiple successes; a critical success counts as two successes.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Repair.Name: Repair
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Repair.Descripti: Spend 10 minutes using a repair kit and roll Crafting against a GM-set DC to restore Hit Points to a damaged item.
Examine an alchemical item for 10 minutes with alchemist's tools. The Crafting check and its outcome are handled secretly.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Craft.Name: Craft
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Craft.Descriptio: Prepare an item during downtime and roll trained Crafting against the DC determined by the item's level, rarity, and circumstances.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.AdministerFirstA: Stabilize a dying creature with Medicine. The Forge normally calculates the DC as 15 + the target's Dying value and can remove Dying on a success.
Administer first aid to a creature taking persistent bleed damage. The GM sets the DC from the effect; a success assists the next recovery check against the bleeding.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatDisease.Des: Care for a diseased creature for at least 8 hours and roll trained Medicine against the disease DC. Success grants +2, critical success +4, and critical failure −2 to its next save against the disease.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatPoison.Name: Treat Poison
PF2EActionForge.Actions.TreatPoison.Desc: Treat a poisoned creature and roll trained Medicine against the poison DC. Success grants +2, critical success +4, and critical failure −2 to its next save against the poison.
PF2EActionForge.DC.DyingRequired: The target must have the Dying condition.
PF2EActionForge.Roll.StatisticHintNoLore: Choose the skill used to perform this action.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.ManeuverInFlight: Use a fly Speed to perform a difficult aerial maneuver; the GM sets the DC based on the maneuver.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.EarnIncome.Name: Earn Income
PF2EActionForge.Actions.EarnIncome.Descr: Work during downtime using Performance, Crafting, or an appropriate Lore skill. The GM determines the job and DC privately.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.IdentifyMagic.De: Spend 10 minutes identifying detected magic with the skill matching its tradition; the DC and outcome are handled secretly.
Decipher complicated, archaic, or esoteric writing with an appropriate skill; the check is secret.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.LearnASpell.Name: Learn a Spell
PF2EActionForge.Actions.LearnASpell.Desc: Learn a spell from your tradition. Choose the appropriate tradition skill and spell rank or standard DC; rarity can increase the DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.PrepareFromSpell: As an arcane prepared spellcaster, prepare a spell from another caster's spellbook; the GM sets the DC from spell rank and rarity.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.CreateForgery.De: Create a forged document during downtime with Society. The GM makes the secret check against DC 20.
Give an animal a command and roll Nature against its Will DC; attitude and circumstances can modify the DC.
PF2EActionForge.LearnSpell.DCHint: Choose the standard table DC. Uncommon or rare spells can use a higher DC set by the GM.
PF2EActionForge.LearnSpell.CustomDCHint: Optional DC for rarity or special circumstances. Clear the field or choose a table value to return to the standard selection.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Escape.Name: Escape
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Escape.Descripti: Break free from immobilized, restrained, or grabbed. Choose unarmed, Acrobatics, or Athletics; a creature target uses its Athletics DC by default, while other restraints can use a manual Escape DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.SenseMotive.Name: Sense Motive
PF2EActionForge.Actions.SenseMotive.Desc: Make a secret Perception check against a creature's Deception DC or another appropriate GM-set DC to judge unusual or deceptive behavior.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Seek.Name: Seek
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Seek.Description: Scan a limited area in encounter mode. PF2e makes the Perception check secretly and the GM compares it against relevant detection DCs.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Aid.Name: Aid
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Aid.Description: Help an ally with a skill check or attack roll. The Forge covers skill-based Aid against the usual DC 15 or a GM-adjusted DC.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.ExplorationSearc: Thoroughly look for hidden doors, hazards, and objects while exploring. Relevant secret Perception checks occur when there is actually something to discover.
Follow an expert ally's exploration tactic and use their assistance for repeated skill checks. Choose the ally and the relevant skill.
Continuously sustain a sustainable effect during exploration while traveling at the activity's reduced pace.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Hustle.Name: Hustle
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Hustle.Descripti: Travel at double travel speed during exploration. The time you can maintain the pace depends on Constitution.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.DetectMagicExplo: Repeatedly cast Detect Magic during exploration and travel more slowly so magical auras are not missed.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Scout.Name: Scout
PF2EActionForge.Actions.Scout.Descriptio: Watch ahead and behind the group for danger. At the start of the next encounter the group gains the activity's +1 circumstance bonus to initiative.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.AvoidNoticeExplo: Travel stealthily during exploration. At the start of an encounter, Stealth can become relevant for initiative and whether enemies notice you.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.InvestigateExplo: Look for information in your surroundings. The GM can call for appropriate secret Recall Knowledge checks when clues become relevant.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.DefendExploratio: Explore with your shield raised. If an encounter begins, you gain the benefit of Raise a Shield before your first turn.
PF2EActionForge.Actions.RepeatASpell.Des: Repeatedly cast the same spell with a casting time of no more than 2 actions during exploration so it can already be active when needed.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.Started: {action} is now this character's active exploration activity.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.Cleared: The active exploration activity has ended.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.StoreFailed: The exploration activity could not be stored on the Actor.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.ClearFailed: The exploration activity could not be ended.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.WorkflowHint: No immediate d20 roll is forced here. The Forge remembers the activity on the acting Actor; secret or situational checks happen later when they become relevant during exploration.
PF2EActionForge.Exploration.FollowExpert: Choose the skill or Lore in which you are following the selected expert.
PF2EActionForge.CoreUtility.EscapeStatis: Choose Unarmed, Acrobatics, or Athletics. PF2e uses the selected method for the Escape check.
PF2EActionForge.CoreUtility.AidDCHint: The usual DC is 15; the GM can adjust it for especially easy or difficult assistance.
PF2EActionForge.CoreUtility.AidCustomDCH: Optional DC adjusted by the GM or the situation.
PF2EActionForge.CoreUtility.AidStatistic: Choose the skill used for the described assistance. Attack-roll Aid remains a situational PF2e variant outside this skill selector.
PF2EActionForge.DC.SharedTargetsValue: {count} targets · {defense} is resolved by the GM after the same check.
PF2EActionForge.SharedRoll.Heading: Shared roll
PF2EActionForge.SharedRoll.SummaryHint: One check was compared against the DCs of all selected targets.
PF2EActionForge.SharedRoll.NoActiveGM: An active GM must be connected to resolve this multi-target check.
PF2EActionForge.SharedRoll.Failed: The shared check was rolled, but GM-side multi-target resolution failed.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.HealersToo: This action requires a healer's toolkit.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.Alchemists: Identifying an alchemical item requires an alchemist's toolkit.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.ThievesToo: This mechanism may require thieves’ tools. The Forge allows the check because the GM decides whether they are required for a particular device.
Picking a lock normally requires thieves’ tools. The Forge allows the check because the GM can permit improvised tools.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.FlySpeed: Maneuver in Flight requires a usable fly Speed.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.AnimalTarg: Command an Animal requires a target with the animal trait.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.DyingTarge: Stabilize requires a target at 0 HP with the dying condition.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.BleedingTa: Stop Bleeding requires a target taking persistent bleed damage.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.LivingWoun: Treat Wounds requires a living, wounded creature.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.FollowExpe: Follow the Expert requires the selected ally to be at least expert in the selected skill.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.Validation: The action prerequisites could not be validated reliably. An active GM is required for this target.
PF2EActionForge.Prerequisites.GenericFai: The prerequisites for this action are not met.
